Archival Dispatch: 30 Master Broadcasts Dated Across This I Believe, Cecil & Sally, Easy Aces, and Aunt Mary

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: This I Believe, Edward R. Murrow, Pearl S. Buck, Alfred Drake, Cecil and Sally, Easy Aces, Jane Ace, Aunt Mary, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 40 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 40 resolves 30 philosophical essays, early radio comedies, and daytime drama broadcasts: 8 personal statement broadcasts hosted by Edward R. Murrow on This I Believe (1952–1954, featuring Nobel laureate Pearl S. Buck and Broadway star Alfred Drake), 8 early 1930 transcription discs from Cecil and Sally, 7 classic domestic comedy episodes from Goodman and Jane Ace's Easy Aces (Spring 1941), and 7 dramatic chapters from the Mutual Don Lee network serial Aunt Mary (January 1945).

1. This I Believe — 1952–1954 Edward R. Murrow Philosophy Essays

Broadcasting personal philosophies to a worldwide radio audience:
